noticeTestSent: Test sent to {email}. If it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder.
noticeRestored: “{name}” is back to the default text.
promptTestAddress: Which address should we send the “{name}” test to?
confirmRestore: Restore “{name}” ({channel} · {locale}) to the product's default text?
variablesTitle: Available variables (unresolved ones are left empty):
transactionalNote: Transactional email — only the Email channel in Spanish (es-ES) can be customised.

auth_password_reset.name: Password reset
auth_password_reset.description: When a user asks to reset their password (or an admin sends them the access invitation).
auth_password_reset.structuralNote: The “Reset password” button with the secure link is always added at the end.

member_registration_otp_code.name: Access code (OTP)
member_registration_otp_code.description: One-time code during member sign-up (email verification).
member_registration_otp_code.structuralNote: The one-time code is always shown in large type below the text.

vars.code: The code (also shown in large type automatically)

member_registration_approval_request.name: New registration pending (to the approver)
member_registration_approval_request.description: Notice to the approver when a pending member registration request arrives.
member_registration_approval_request.structuralNote: The applicant’s details (group, unpaid payments, subscriptions, purchases) and the “Approve”/“Reject” buttons are always added after the text.

member_registration_welcome_approved.name: Registration approved (welcome)
member_registration_welcome_approved.description: When the approver approves the member’s registration request.
member_registration_welcome_approved.structuralNote: The “Sign in” button with the access link is always added at the end.

member_registration_rejection.name: Registration rejected
member_registration_rejection.description: When the approver rejects the member’s registration request.

enrollment_welcome.name: Welcome after API sign-up
enrollment_welcome.description: When an external sign-up through the API (n8n/Woo) creates a new user with access to course(s).
enrollment_welcome.structuralNote: The “Set your password” button with the magic link is always added at the end.

vars.name: User’s name (may be empty)
vars.setPasswordUrl: Magic link to set the password

membership_welcome.name: Membership welcome
membership_welcome.description: When a membership purchase (Stripe webhook) creates the buyer as a user.
membership_welcome.structuralNote: The “Set my password” button and the note with the sign-in URL are always added.

vars.name: Buyer’s name (may be empty)
vars.setPasswordUrl: Magic link to set the password

billing_welcome.name: Course purchase welcome
billing_welcome.description: When the public purchase of a single course (Stripe webhook) creates the buyer as a user.
billing_welcome.structuralNote: The “Set my password” button and the note with the sign-in URL are always added.

vars.name: Buyer’s name (may be empty)
vars.setPasswordUrl: Magic link to set the password

subscriptions_renewal_warning.name: Renewal notice to the subscriber
subscriptions_renewal_warning.description: Automatic notice N days before the member’s external subscription renews.
subscriptions_renewal_warning.structuralNote: If a Stripe portal is set up, the “Manage my subscription” button is added at the end.

payment_connections_access_expiring.name: Access ending notice (one-off payment with an expiry date)
payment_connections_access_expiring.description: Automatic notice N days before an access bought in a single payment ends (e.g. “ANNUAL access”). It is DIFFERENT from the renewal notice: this access does not renew on its own, it has to be bought again.
payment_connections_access_expiring.structuralNote: No button: there is no portal to manage, renewing is a new purchase in the store.

subscriptions_admin_digest.name: Daily subscriptions digest (admins)
subscriptions_admin_digest.description: Daily digest to admins with the active subscriptions and upcoming renewals.

enrollment_created.name: Enrolment created
enrollment_created.description: When a student enrols in a course.

course_completed.name: Course completed
course_completed.description: When a student completes 100% of a course.

certificate_issued.name: Certificate issued
certificate_issued.description: When the certificate for a completed course is issued.

attempt_passed.name: Quiz passed
attempt_passed.description: When a quiz attempt clears the pass mark.

attempt_failed.name: Quiz not passed
attempt_failed.description: When a quiz attempt falls below the pass mark.

attempt_graded.name: Quiz graded by the instructor
attempt_graded.description: When the instructor grades an attempt manually.

admin_smtp_test.name: SMTP test
admin_smtp_test.description: Test email sent when checking the SMTP configuration.

community_mention.name: Community mention
community_mention.description: When someone mentions you in a post or comment.

community_comment_on_post.name: Comment on your post
community_comment_on_post.description: When someone comments on one of your posts.

community_reply_to_comment.name: Reply to your comment
community_reply_to_comment.description: When someone replies to one of your comments.

community_digest_weekly.name: Weekly community digest
community_digest_weekly.description: Weekly digest with pending mentions and replies.

vars.unsubUrl: Unsubscribe link for community emails (digest and notices)

community_broadcast.name: Community notice (broadcast)
community_broadcast.description: Mass notice sent from /admin/broadcasts. The admin writes the subject and the body when sending it.

vars.subject: Subject written by the admin
vars.postUrl: Link to the post (empty if the notice has none)
vars.unsubUrl: Unsubscribe link for community emails: notices and digest (email only)

lesson_unlocked.name: Lesson unlocked
lesson_unlocked.description: When a lesson scheduled by date unlocks (drip).

gamification_level_reached.name: New level reached
gamification_level_reached.description: When a member crosses the points of a level.

gamification_challenge_approved.name: Challenge approved
gamification_challenge_approved.description: When the team approves a challenge submission and credits the points.

vars.title: Challenge title
vars.reviewNote: Feedback from the team (may be empty)

gamification_challenge_rejected.name: Challenge not approved
gamification_challenge_rejected.description: When the team rejects a challenge submission.

vars.title: Challenge title
vars.reviewNote: Reason or what is missing (may be empty)

gamification_staff_pending.name: Team notice: something to review
gamification_staff_pending.description: When a challenge submission or a perk request arrives. Only inside the platform.

gamification_perk_handled.name: Perk request handled
gamification_perk_handled.description: When the team approves, completes or rejects a perk request.

vars.statusText: Sentence for the outcome (approved, done or rejected)
vars.staffNote: Reply from the team (may be empty)

referrals_commission_earned.name: Referral commission earned
referrals_commission_earned.description: When a payment from a referred person generates a commission for the member.

vars.baseAmount: Amount of the payment that generated it

referrals_payout_recorded.name: Referral payout made
referrals_payout_recorded.description: When the admin records the payout of approved commissions.

zoom_class_registration_confirmed.name: Live class registration confirmed
zoom_class_registration_confirmed.description: When a member signs up for a live class (Zoom virtual classroom).

vars.calendarGoogleUrl: Link to add the class to Google Calendar
vars.calendarIcsUrl: Download of the .ics event (Outlook, Apple Calendar and others)

zoom_class_reminder.name: Live class reminder (2 h before)
zoom_class_reminder.description: Automatic notice to registrants shortly before the class starts. It is sent only once per class; if the class is rescheduled, it is sent again for the new time.

vars.startsAt: When it starts, in the instructor’s time zone
vars.hoursBefore: How many hours in advance the notice goes out (2 by default)
vars.calendarGoogleUrl: Link to add the class to Google Calendar
vars.calendarIcsUrl: Download of the .ics event (Outlook, Apple Calendar and others)

zoom_class_cancelled.name: Live class cancelled
zoom_class_cancelled.description: When a live class is cancelled, it notifies every registered member.

vars.startsAt: Date and time the class was scheduled for

surveys_post_class_invitation.name: Post-class survey
surveys_post_class_invitation.description: When a live class ends, it invites each registrant to rate it (anonymous answer).

surveys_post_class_reminder.name: Post-class survey reminder
surveys_post_class_reminder.description: 24 h after the survey is created, it reminds ONLY the registrants who have not answered yet to rate the class (a single reminder per class).
